rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Bédard (United States, before 2019).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in before 2019 as 'Love at First Sight'.
rows.Bloom: Red, lighter reverse. Mild, fruity fragrance. 45 to 65 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Medium to large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Glossy foliage.

Height: 3' to 42" (90 to 105cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b through 9b. Can be used for cut flower.
